title: Difficult conversations
learning_outcomes: Explain purpose and facts in the context of difficult conversations.
Compare and distinguish observation versus interpretation in the context of difficult conversations.
Apply constructive requests in the context of difficult conversations.
Evaluate and justify decisions about repair in the context of difficult conversations.

lessons.title: Purpose and facts
lessons.outcome: Explain purpose and facts in the context of difficult conversations.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving purpose and facts; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to difficult conversation simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain purpose and facts from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of purpose and facts; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Observation versus interpretation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish observation versus interpretation in the context of difficult conversations.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving observation versus interpretation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to difficult conversation simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain observation versus interpretation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of observation versus interpretation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Constructive requests
lessons.outcome: Apply constructive requests in the context of difficult conversations.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving constructive requests; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to difficult conversation simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain constructive requests from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of constructive requests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Repair
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about repair in the context of difficult conversations.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving repair; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to difficult conversation simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain repair from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of purpose and facts; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of observation versus interpretation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of constructive requests; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of repair; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
